I migrated 40 AEM sites to the cloud in nine months.

The hardest part wasn't the tech. It was convincing each business team to delete components they no longer used. We removed 212 out of 530.

My rule, in the end: if nobody can say what a component is for, we disable it for one sprint. If nobody complains, we delete it.

What's the most useless component you've ever had to maintain?
